newTab: Read out by screen readers after a link that opens another browser tab.
confirm.cancel: Default button of a confirmation dialog that closes it without doing anything.
confirm.busy: Why the Cancel button is unavailable while the dialog's action is running.
toggle.on: State word written beside an on/off switch that is on. Very short.
toggle.off: State word written beside an on/off switch that is off. Very short.
disclosure.more: Row that reveals more advanced settings below it. Short.
disclosure.less: The same row once open: hides the advanced settings again. Short.
select.placeholder: Shown in a drop-down list that has nothing chosen yet.
select.labelValue: Screen-reader name of a drop-down. {label}: what it sets; {value}: what it is set to now, both already translated.
settingRow.changed: Tooltip on the small dot beside a setting that is no longer at its default value.
settingRow.resetNamed: Screen-reader name of a setting's reset button. {setting}: the setting's name, already translated.
settingRow.resetThis: Screen-reader name of a setting's reset button when the setting has no plain-text name.
settingRow.reset: Tooltip on a setting's reset button.
mediaTile.chosen: Screen-reader name of the check mark on the picture tile (car, circuit, livery) that is currently chosen.
keys.up: Screen-reader name of the Up arrow key, drawn as an arrow.
keys.down: Screen-reader name of the Down arrow key.
keys.left: Screen-reader name of the Left arrow key.
keys.right: Screen-reader name of the Right arrow key.
keys.wheelButton: A racing wheel's button shown by number in a small key cap. Btn = button; keep it very short. {button}: the number.
pad.namedButton: Screen-reader name of a controller button. {name}: the letter or name printed on it (A, Menu, Options), not translated.
pad.shapeButton: Screen-reader names of the PlayStation face buttons (cross, circle, square, triangle). Use the names Sony uses in your language.
pad.faceButton: Screen-reader names of a generic controller's four face buttons, by position.
pad.dpad: The directional pad of a game controller. Keep D-pad if your language uses it.
pad.dpadDirection: The directional pad pressed in a direction: up, down, left, right, left and right, up and down.
pad.shoulder: Screen-reader name of a shoulder button or trigger. {name}: what is printed on it (LB, R2), not translated.
pad.touchpad: The touch-sensitive pad on a PlayStation controller.
pad.stick: A controller's left or right thumbstick.
pad.stickPress: Pressing a thumbstick down as a button. {name}: what the button is called (LS, R3), not translated.
pad.stickDirection: A thumbstick pushed in a direction.
badges.you: Tag marking the player's own row in a list or result. Very short.
badges.position: Screen-reader text for a race or board position shown as P1, P2. {position}: the number.
badges.qualityDescription: Read out right after a circuit's or car's grade badge (such as Original): the colon and what the grade means. {description}: already translated.
delta.spoken: Screen-reader text for a time gap. {seconds}: the gap such as 0.214. faster = time gained, slower = time lost; ', best' is added when it is the overall best.
delta.best: Word in a time-gap badge marking an overall best time. Very short.
penalty.time: A time penalty in seconds. {seconds}: the number. s = seconds, keep the unit.
penalty.driveThrough: Penalty: drive through the pit lane without stopping.
penalty.warning: A race-control warning (black and white flag).
penalty.trackLimits: Track-limits strikes: {strikes} used out of {of} allowed.
penalty.disqualified: Removed from the race results (black flag).
flags.doubleYellow: Double yellow flag: two waved yellow flags, a serious hazard.
flags.blackWhite: The black and white diagonal flag: a warning for unsporting behaviour.
flags.chequered: The chequered flag that ends a race or session.
compounds.name.soft: Tyre compound name, in badges and menus.
compounds.name.intermediate: Tyre compound name: for a damp or lightly wet track.
compounds.name.wet: Tyre compound name: full wet tyres for standing water.
compounds.short.medium: Short form of Medium (tyre compound) in a narrow picker.
compounds.short.intermediate: Short form of Intermediate (tyre compound) in a narrow picker.
compounds.long.intermediate: Spoken name of the intermediate tyres, with when they are used.
compounds.long.wet: Spoken name of the full wet tyres, with when they are used.
compounds.tyres.soft: Screen-reader name of the drawn tyre compound symbol.
carClass.openWheel: Car class: single-seater racing cars with uncovered wheels (Formula cars).
carClass.gt3: Car class name. Usually kept as GT3.
carClass.proto: Car class: prototype sports cars (Le Mans style). Short for prototype.
carClass.classic: Car class: classic racing cars from past decades.
session.practice: Session type: driving alone, no race.
session.timeAttack: Session type: chasing the fastest lap time.
session.hillClimb: Session type: one timed run up a hill road.
session.host: Badge: you host this online race.
state.new: Badge on a car or circuit that was just added.
state.beta: Badge on a car or circuit that is still being tested.
state.wip: Badge: work in progress. Use your language's short form if it has one.
state.inUse: Badge on the car or circuit currently selected.
surface.dry: State of the track surface: no water.
surface.damp: State of the track surface: slightly wet.
surface.wet: State of the track surface: wet.
surface.flooded: State of the track surface: standing water.
session.online: Badge: connected to an online race.
dialog.close: Screen-reader name of the X button that closes a window.
